05Projects

Things I've built

One project cleans up data no human has time to check by hand; the other checks something no dataset was going to give me — actual water, in an actual test tube.

Project 01

Agentic AI System for Ensuring Reliability in Survey Data Analytics

An AI-powered pipeline that uses agentic AI and large language models to improve the quality of survey data before anyone tries to draw conclusions from it.

  • Automated detection and correction of missing values, duplicate entries, outliers, and inconsistent responses.
  • Generated analytical insights to support more accurate, defensible decision-making downstream.

Project 02

Predicting the Quality of Water Using Optical Detection

A low-cost, IoT-based water quality monitor built from an Arduino Nano and an optical sensor housed in a hand-built cardboard rig — because a proper enclosure can come later, the physics can't wait.

  • Real-time monitoring and analysis of water clarity using optical sensing techniques.
  • Averaged sensor readings over multiple samples for stability, then classified the result as clear or not clear.
  • Improved water quality assessment through automated, repeatable data collection instead of visual judgement.
